### 1. Standard Documents Required
* **Experience Criteria**
* **Past Performance**
* **Bidder Turnover**
* **OEM Authorization Certificate**
* **OEM Annual Turnover**

### 2. Clarified ATC Documents & Mandatory Uploads
* **Certificate**: **Undertaking regarding non-liquidation/bankruptcy**, **Copy of PAN Card**, **Copy of GSTIN**, **Copy of Cancelled Cheque**, **Copy of EFT Mandate (Bank Certified)**, **OEM/Original Service Provider Authorization Form/Certificate**, **Certificate of Registered Office in India (for imported products)**, **OEM Warranty Certificates**, **Details of Service Centres in India**, **Bid Security Declaration**, **Price Breakdown (CD, GST, Freight, etc.)**, **OEM Price List (verifiable with Bill of Entry)**, **Para-wise compliance of specifications**, **Form Fit Function (FFF) Certificate (if part no./description changes)**, **Undertaking letter for ATC acceptance**, **Scanned ATC document with authorized signature and stamp**.
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **Relevant contracts for 2 years of supply experience**, **Scanned copy of GST invoice and GST portal payment screenshot (at time of invoicing)**.

### 3. Exemption Documents Required
* **Proof for Exemption (MSEs)**: **Udyam Registration Certificate** (Inferred)
* **Proof for Exemption (Start-ups)**: **DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate** (Inferred)

### 4. Physical Submissions (Offline)
* None specified in the provided text.

### 5. Key Commercial Terms & Conditions to Follow
* **Procurement Mode**: Restricted to **M/s Dynatron Services, New Delhi** (PAC Basis).
* **Option Clause**: Purchaser may increase/decrease quantity by up to 50% at contracted rates; delivery period adjustments apply.
* **Inspection**: Pre-dispatch inspection by **CQAE** at seller premises; inspection charges borne by the seller.
* **Warranty**: 1 year from final acceptance/installation.
* **Payment Terms**: 90% on delivery and 10% on accounting.
* **Performance Security**: **PBG @ 5%** required if order value exceeds 5 Lakhs.
* **Bid Security**: Mandatory submission of **Bid Security Declaration** in the specified format; failure results in 6-month suspension.
* **Delivery Period**: 180 days from PO date (includes 30 days inspection lead time).
